contentText: Delano D'Souza welcomes former US Ambassador Mark C. Storella, Professor of the Practice of Diplomacy at Boston University. He offers a sobering analysis of US immigration, and both foreign & economic policies. He warns the US that is not only isolating itself on the global stage, but also undercutting its own economy and moral authority. Authoritarian opportunism, disguised as pragmatism, risks weakening America’s alliances, its values and its democratic norms.
